criteria.description: One centered copy group, one email capture, and one landscape lightbox with no extra navigation or brand chrome
The field and submit use CSS Grid, stack below 40rem, and align as two columns from 40rem
Header, preview, and pagination use the shared 32px outer rhythm with one preview frame
No horizontal overflow from 320px through 1280px and media stays landscape
Email validation and success announcement work; lightbox restores focus after close
Semantic controls, named dialog, touch targets, focus visibility, reduced motion, and axe WCAG 2.1 AA
Native form and readable media fallback remain available without JavaScript
